Tom Snare
Xavier Decanter
(
French pronunciation:
[
ɡzavje
dəkɑ̃tɛʁ
]
), better known as his stage name
Tom Snare
, is a French DJ and record producer from
Dunkirk
.
Career
Tom Snare rose to fame with a hit single, "Philosophy", with reached #2 in France in early 2006 and is now on the playlist of world famous DJs and bands such as
Robbie Rivera
,
Global Deejays
and
Hi_Tack
. Tom Snare have also released singles under other aliases, such as Blue Star, Pure Star, Master Of Sciences and Undertalk. Tom Snare's first album,
Tom Snare's World
, was released in October 2006.
